rationale: MEOH has already gapped up ~6.7% on strong earnings and is trading at 82% of its intraday range near the session high after a large move, with the broader market under significant stress (SPY -2.29%, VIXY +15.82%). The stock is extended well above VWAP ($69.67) with only 77 minutes to close, making a long entry late-cycle and high-risk for a reversal, while shorting a strong earnings catalyst with momentum still intact and price holding above the 9-EMA is equally dangerous. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable given the compressed time window and the stock's position in its range.
